dataset.source_ledger: internal provenance ledger not included in compact public checkout

preprocessing.gm_map: FastSPM SPM12 Unified Segmentation, modulated normalized GM (mwc1)
preprocessing.csf_map: FastSPM SPM12 Unified Segmentation, modulated normalized CSF (mwc3)
preprocessing.feature_grid: 4 mm smoothing, 4 mm resampling, fixed brain mask, within-subject z normalization

split_policy.train: fit feature transforms and any retrained prediction head
split_policy.calibration: fit age-bias correction and choose development settings
split_policy.test: locked final evaluation only; never used for fitting or tuning

experiments.bias_correction: calibration-only affine correction applied after prediction
experiments.csf: feature-age signal and optional calibration-only fusion; no promoted CSF head
experiments.cortical_thickness: label-blind exploratory branch; no promoted prediction head
experiments.age_aware: group-aware representation benchmark; separate from the production head
